description: pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:120 — validate_attribute_cert is a non-functional stub that always returns Err(AaPathInvalid(NoTrustedPath)). The doc says 'Not yet implemented'. compare pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:99 which correctly marks verify_scts #[deprecated = "..."] with a message explaining the stub behaviour. validate_attribute_cert must have the same treatment so callers get a compile-time warning when they depend on a no-op function. Fix: add #[deprecated = "pkix-ac is not yet implemented; this function always returns AaPathInvalid"] above the fn.
title: [rusty/pkix-ac] validate_attribute_cert stub not marked #[deprecated]
